 ;
 ;This routine is automatically triggered by the PCE Event Driver (DGPMDDCV)
 ;when a patient movement account is created, updated, or cancelled.
 ;The process is called from event updater routine DGPMDDCV where the data
 ;from the DGPM movement requests are transferred to the PTF INCONSISTENT RECORD file.
 ;If needed, data in the later file will be transferred to appropriate movements.
 ;
 ;DGPMA - DGPM movement account node
 ;DGPMP - DGPM proposed movement node
 ;DGPMT - DGPM movement type
